project.title: Integrating Electrocoagulation Process with Anaerobic Digestion for In-situ Biomethanation and Performance Improvement
project.description: The integration of the electrocoagulation (EC) process with anaerobic digestion for in-situ biomethanation was studied. EC operational conditions was as follow:iron electrodes1.5 mA/cm2 current densitypower supply: 10-min-ON, 30-min-OFF.the EC process altered microbial community and stimulated some functional microorganisms, such as Acinetobacter in bacterial and Methanobacterium in the archaeal community.
